    01 · SCOPE

    Public projection only

    Private inventory rows and local identity or credential diagnostics are not part of this published surface.

    02 · PROVENANCE

    Source and revision together

    An asset name is not evidence by itself. The atlas keeps the observed source URL, revision, and timestamp beside the claim.

    03 · INTERPRETATION

    Unknown stays unknown

    A green workflow is not proof that every workflow or the current head passed. Artifact names do not prove successful training or inference.
